jurisdictional_context: MIVILUDES has on multiple occasions flagged SAP as a concept warranting vigilance; HAS has issued no recommandation de bonne pratique endorsing SAP as a diagnostic category; the CIIVISE 2023 rapport final extensively documented SAP allegations as a defensive technique used in family-court proceedings against DV-disclosing mothers; Code civil art. 373-2 + 373-2-11 vest wide discretion in the juge aux affaires familiales (JAF) with expertise judiciaire routine; loi n° 2024-233 of 18 March 2024 tightened the framework where intrafamily violence is alleged; CRIP departemental child-protection unit (CASF art. L226-3) is routine first-line actor; SFPEADA and Academie nationale de medecine have not endorsed SAP; ACALPA NGO is the central French recognition-camp civil-society anchor; in November 2024 juge Edouard Durand was not reappointed to the reconstituted CIIVISE under Sebastien Boueilh, a politically contested decision that did not restore institutional legitimacy to SAP.

structural_finding: France presents a uniquely asymmetric PA-clinical landscape: no French autorite publique (HAS, Academie nationale de medecine, SFPEADA, CNPE) has ever endorsed SAP as a diagnostic category, while MIVILUDES has on multiple occasions issued vigilance signals. The CIIVISE 2023 rapport final reframed the debate from 'is SAP scientifically valid?' to 'how is SAP used in court?' — answering: as a defensive technique against DV-disclosing mothers. The loi n° 2024-233 of 18 March 2024 and the November 2024 non-reappointment of juge Edouard Durand to the reconstituted CIIVISE under Sebastien Boueilh form a single political sequence whose net effect is to harden the critique-camp position institutionally while politicising the personnel who carried it. The recognition camp rests on a small number of named clinical voices (Bensussan, Delfieu, Biolley) and one NGO (ACALPA), with no university chair, no societe savante endorsement, and no HAS recommendation; the critique camp is institutionally embedded across CIIVISE, Delegation aux droits des femmes, MIPROF, CNPE, Universite Paris Nanterre, the victimologie clinical-academic field, and the medecine legale community. The asymmetry is institutional, not merely numerical.
